question: Himalaya is important for the climate of North India because:

options.text: it prevents the southwest monsoon winds from escaping from India
it helps the western disturbances to escape from Arabic sea
it allows the winds from the Bay of Bengal to escape from India
it allows the southwest monsoon winds to escape from India

solution:
The correct answer is__** it prevents the southwest monsoon winds from escaping from India.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The Himalayas play a very significant role in** influencing the climate of India.**
 
• By virtue of their** high altitude, length, **and direction,** they effectively intercept the summer monsoons **coming from the **Bay of Bengal and the Arabian Sea and cause precipitation in the form of rain or snow.**

** Significance of Himalayas for India:- **

 
• **Source of Rivers:**

 
 
• Abundant rainfall and vast snow fields as well as** large glaciers in the Himalayas** are the feeding grounds of the** mighty rivers of India.**
 
• The **great rivers and their tributaries **carry enormous **quantities of alluviu**m while descending from the Himalayas.
 
• This is deposited in the **Great Plain of North India **in the form of fertile soil,** making the plain** one of the most fertile lands in the world.
 
 
 
• **Critical for India’s Energy Security:**
 
 
• **Almost 33%** of the country’s **thermal electricity and 52%** of its hydropower is dependent on river waters **originating in the Himalayas.**
 
• These rivers receive a **significant part of their water **from the melting of glaciers, making them a **critical component **of India’s energy security and water security needs.
 
 
 
• **Forest Wealth:**
 
 
• The Himalayan ranges are** very rich in forest resources.**
 
• In their altitude, the Himalayan ranges s**how a succession of vegetal **cover from the **tropical to the Alpine.**
 
• The Himalayan **forests provide fuel wood** and a large variety of raw materials for **forest-based industries.**
 
• Besides, many **medicinal plants grow** in the Himalayan region.
 
 
 
• **Tourism:**
 
 
• By virtue of their** scenic beauty and healthy environment,** the Himalayan ranges have developed a **large number of tourist spots.**
 
• The hilly areas in the Himalayas offer a cool and **comfortable climate **when the neighboring plains are reeling under the scorching heat of the **summer season.**
